hypotheses.evidence: Only 7 at-risk validation samples versus 996 not-at-risk samples.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Limited minority-class representation may reduce sensitivity to churn indicators.
hypotheses.verification: Inspect training class counts, compare per-class learning behavior, and evaluate controlled class-balancing interventions.
hypotheses.remediation: Consider targeted annotation, minority-class sampling, or loss adjustments. Change one factor at a time.

hypotheses.evidence: Three persistent false negatives occur in billing_and_charges, including explicit switching or cancellation language.
hypotheses.hypothesis: The model may under-recognize churn signals when embedded in billing complaints.
hypotheses.verification: Audit training examples by churn label and complaint category; compare matched examples with similar churn expressions.
hypotheses.remediation: Collect and annotate diverse billing-related churn examples, then run controlled experiments.

hypotheses.evidence: frustrated_0030.wav is labeled at_risk but does not contain an explicit intention to leave.
hypotheses.hypothesis: The annotation policy may include implicit trust-loss indicators, creating a broader definition than explicit cancellation intent.
hypotheses.verification: Review original annotation guidelines and obtain blinded independent annotation.
hypotheses.remediation: Clarify the operational definition of at_risk and adjudicate ambiguous cases without using model predictions as ground truth.

hypotheses.evidence: High urgency has mean precision approximately 0.410 and recall approximately 0.781.
hypotheses.hypothesis: The classifier may favor recall over precision for high urgency.
hypotheses.verification: Inspect confusion pairs, decision margins, training distribution, and label criteria.
hypotheses.remediation: Evaluate validation-only threshold or decision-rule adjustments against a predefined precision-recall objective.

hypotheses.evidence: mad has mean precision approximately 0.383 and recall approximately 0.848.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Expressions of frustration may overlap linguistically with anger.
hypotheses.verification: Review true/predicted confusion pairs and conduct blinded annotation review.
hypotheses.remediation: Refine class definitions and test targeted examples with consistent annotation.

hypotheses.evidence: Some original and Whisper transcripts differ, but the exact model input column has not yet been independently confirmed.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Transcription errors could influence predictions for certain complaints.
hypotheses.verification: Confirm the tokenization input column and perform a controlled ASR-input ablation.
hypotheses.remediation: Improve transcription quality only if a controlled experiment demonstrates benefit.
